title: Chemical analyses of the eastern australian potassic suite: whole-rock major and trace element geochemistry including loss on ignition

notes: These data represent the most complete set of analyses of the Eastern Australian Potassic suite. The data include whole-rock major-, and trace-element analyses including loss-on-ignition measurements for 47 samples from 21 spatially distinct leucite-bearing volcanic surface expressions. These expressions range from topographically prominent volcanic edifices and mounds, through to lava flows, with three sample locations (6 samples total) coming from active quarry sites. Location and elevation data as well as methods used are provided. Trace-element data are available for 44 samples, and include a total of 42 elements. All samples have major element analyses (10 elements).
